Metadata.Goal: Add Kunun prefix-annotation support for ORM relation implementation metadata.
Metadata.Description: Track relation annotations that let one relation declaration serve ontology typing and depa-orm-style ORM implementation metadata.

TaskSpace.name: add-relation-orm-annotations
TaskSpace.Description: Add prefix ORM annotations for relation declarations.

TaskGroup.name: Annotation profile parser
TaskGroup.Description: Implement a typed ORM relation annotation profile over Kunun prefix annotations.

Task.name: Define normalized relation annotation descriptor
Task.Description: Add descriptor types for cardinality, endpoints, through path segments, constraints, and write behavior.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Descriptors can represent depa-orm RelationshipDefinition and RelationPathThrough concepts.

Task.name: Parse prefix ORM relation marker
Task.Description: Parse `#(orm #relation :{ ... })` markers from relation Knot pre modifiers.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Profile parsing accepts endpoint, through, constraint, and write items.

TaskGroup.name: Type-system relation integration
TaskGroup.Description: Connect relation declarations with annotation extraction while preserving core relation semantics.

Task.name: Preserve relation annotation access
Task.Description: Ensure downstream tooling can access relation prefix annotations after parsing/binding.

Task.name: Protect core type compatibility
Task.Description: Add tests proving ORM annotations do not affect row compatibility or schema subtype checks.

Task.name: Add field business type profiles
Task.Description: Add domain and ORM field annotation profiles so depa-orm scalar/business types stay outside the core type registry.

TaskGroup.name: Migration examples and verification
TaskGroup.Description: Add depa-orm migration examples and run focused verification.

Task.name: Add depa-orm mapping fixtures
Task.Description: Cover RelationshipDefinition to Kunun relation plus prefix annotation mappings, including through paths.

Task.name: Run tests and typecheck
Task.Description: Run type-annotations tests, type-system relation tests, and workspace typecheck.
